title: The Goose That Laid the Golden Eggs
text:
A poor farmer and his wife owned a goose. One morning the farmer went to the nest and found an egg that was yellow and heavy and glittered in the light. He thought someone was playing a trick on him, but when he took it to be tested, it turned out to be solid gold.

The next morning the goose laid another golden egg, and the next morning another. Each day there was one, and the couple soon began to grow rich. They bought land and fine things and lived better than they ever had.

But as their wealth grew, so did their impatience. One egg a day began to seem too slow. If the goose could make gold, they reasoned, she must be full of it inside. Why wait day after day, when they could have all of it at once?

So they killed the goose and cut her open. Inside they found nothing but an ordinary goose, no different from any other. There was no hoard of gold, and now there would be no more eggs. The couple had destroyed the only thing that had made them rich.
lesson: Protect whatever produces your steady gains, whether it is a business, a relationship or your own health. Squeezing it for everything at once can leave you with nothing.
people: A farmer and his wife, a goose
